target_trajectory.mesh: target_unified_visual in the source episode's replay/geometry.npz, identified by replay/scene.json
target_trajectory.mesh_alignment: Frame-29 transform from replay/trajectory.npz, expressed in the target body frame
target_trajectory.display: Original recorded target origins, T-mesh geometry, pose axes and projection are preserved. Target meshes retain their original orange, face shading and temporal fading, matching the scene illustrations. SE(3) annotations use core red #C0263A, white/red origin dots and RGB axes without white support or extra outlines. History path remains gray; forecast path remains dashed red with 50 ms ticks and no white support.

robot_icon.origin: Original native vector drawing created for this figure
robot_icon.placements: Robot state input, three action symbols in a, and one action-chunk symbol in c

inference_diagram.noise_position: below Action update, aligned with flow time
inference_diagram.iteration: circular arrow inside the action-update block; no external feedback wires
inference_diagram.output: one original robot icon, matching the icon and size in a
inference_diagram.world_cache: fixed conditioning input, computed once per query

flow_context.scope: recorded current poses; meshes clipped only for display; not a predicted state
flow_context.annotations: Native editable time-coloured trajectory arrows at +50, +200, +400 ms. Each recorded 50 ms segment is subdivided three times; turbo 0.12–0.66 encodes time from 0 to +400 ms. Shafts and arrowheads have no outlines, including in the time legend. White origins have a turbo-0.12 rim; static points have a gray rim. Original 3x displacement display scale is retained.

display_processing.flow_background: Saved orthographic camera, clipping, current poses and 1200x640 resolution preserved; shared specular 0.10 / roughness 0.34 and original material colors.

flow.head_color: corresponding horizon on the global 0–400 ms scale

target.mesh: Original orange, face shading and temporal fading; matches the scene illustrations
